briefTitle: A Study of Targeted Post-Surgery Radiation Therapy for Non-Small Cell Lung Cancer With Remaining Lymph Node Cancer After Treatment

typedChecks.sourceText: Age ≥ 18 years
Eastern Cooperative Oncology Group (ECOG) performance status ≤ 2

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Histopathologic diagnosis of NSCLC, may have mixed or multiple histologies but no small cell component
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Mixed or multiple histologies with an exclusion for small cell component cannot be captured by a single precise histology_in check.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: No metastatic disease (M0) per most recent PET/CT and head CT/MRI imaging
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: M0 status and imaging requirements are not mapped to standard typed checks.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: No disease progression per CT chest (including upper abdomen as per standard practice) with intravenous (IV) contrast (unless IV contrast is contraindicated) or FDG-PET performed post-neoadjuvant therapy ≤ 90 days prior to registration, either before or after surgery
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Absence of disease progression on imaging is a clinical assessment not covered by typed checks.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Prior treatment with 2-4 cycles of neoadjuvant systemic therapy with any guideline (National Comprehensive Cancer Network [NCCN]) concordant regimen
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Prior therapy requirement refers to a general guideline-concordant regimen rather than a specific drug name.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Lobectomy or greater oncologic surgical resection within 8 weeks prior to registration
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Surgical resection type and timing is a procedure requirement, not a typed check.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Complete (R0) resection showing ypN2 disease
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Resection margin and nodal status are specialized pathology criteria.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Not pregnant, because this study involves radiation therapy, which has known genotoxic, mutagenic and teratogenic effects. Therefore, for women of childbearing potential only, a negative urine or serum pregnancy test done ≤ 7 days prior to registration is required
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Pregnancy testing and status are standard exclusion criteria not modeled with a typed check.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Patients with a prior or concurrent malignancy whose natural history or treatment does not have the potential to interfere with the safety or efficacy assessment of the investigational regimen are eligible for this trial
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Prior malignancy allowance depends on investigator judgment regarding interference.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Cardiac function: Patients with known history or current symptoms of cardiac disease, or history of treatment with cardiotoxic agents, should have a clinical risk assessment of cardiac function using the New York Heart Association Functional Classification. To be eligible for this trial, patients should be class 2B or better
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: NYHA functional classification requires clinical judgment.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: No idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis requiring anti-fibrotic medication: Patients with idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis or inflammatory/interstitial lung disease compromising pulmonary function or requiring ongoing treatment with nintedanib, pirfenidone, or other anti-fibrotic drug are excluded
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Pulmonary fibrosis and anti-fibrotic drug exclusions are complex clinical rules.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: HIV-infected patients on effective anti-retroviral therapy with an undetectable viral load within 6 months are eligible for this trial
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: HIV infection status with viral load criteria is not a standard typed check.
